title: Patch: hand-hint pips name themselves on hover like field marks do

**Issue #4683 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4683: Patch: hand-hint pips name themselves on hover like field marks do
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Cards in your hand can carry small pips: a trade icon for Tradable, an altar icon with a number for Tribute. Sighted mouse players get no hover text saying what they mean, while the same mark family on field cards on phones does carry hover text. After this, hovering a pip names it ("Tradable", "Tribute", "No Trades left this turn" when dimmed).

## Why

`apps/web/src/game/HandHints.tsx` renders each pip with `aria-label` only and no `title`; `apps/web/src/game/FieldBadges.tsx` sets `title={wordsOf(...)}` on the same icon family, so this is parity with existing chrome. `apps/web/src/game/handHints.ts` ships exactly two hints (Tradable, #2269/#2574 R2574000; Tribute, #2268 R2268000), so the surface is tiny. A new player meeting the altar/"2" pip has nothing in the client naming it until the play flow asks for tributes.

## Proposal

Pass each shown hint's existing translated label as the pip's `title`, and extend the hand-hint tests to hold every rendered pip to its label as hover text, including the dimmed Tradable state.

## Where it lands

`apps/web/src/game/HandHints.tsx` (one attribute) and its tests (`Hand.test.tsx` / `HandHints.test.tsx` patterns); labels already come through `t()` in `handHints.ts`, so the i18n guard keeps passing with no dictionary change and no spec change.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every rendered hand-hint pip carries its screen-reader label as hover text, including the dimmed state.
- [ ] Touch and screen-reader behavior unchanged; no layout or style change.
- [ ] The touched vitest files and the i18n suite pass; no new lint suppressions.

## Size and risks

Small: one attribute plus tests. Risk: none known. Rejected alternative: a visible legend row under the hand (clutters phones for two pips).

| `apps/web/src/game/HandHints.tsx` | `change` | In [`HandHints`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4683/apps/web/src/game/HandHints.tsx#L20-L58), add `title={pip.label}` to the `.hand-hint` `<span>`. |

## Steps
1. In [`apps/web/src/game/HandHints.tsx`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4683/apps/web/src/game/HandHints.tsx):
   - In [`HandHints({ card, view, hints })`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4683/apps/web/src/game/HandHints.tsx#L20-L58), locate the `.hand-hint` `<span>` rendered for each pip in `shown.map(({ hint, shown: pip }) => ...)`.
   - Add the attribute `title={pip.label}` alongside `role="img"` and `aria-label={pip.label}` (matching the pattern in [`FieldBadges.tsx`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4683/apps/web/src/game/FieldBadges.tsx#L128) lines 128 and 135):
   ```tsx
   <span
     key={hint.id}
     className="hand-hint"
     data-hint={hint.id}
     data-dimmed={pip.dimmed === true ? "true" : undefined}
     role="img"
     aria-label={pip.label}
     title={pip.label}
   >
   ```
2. In [`apps/web/src/game/HandHints.test.tsx`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4683/apps/web/src/game/HandHints.test.tsx):
   - In `it("#2267 each pip's accessible label goes through t() in the reader's language")`:
     Assert `expect(screen.getByRole("img", { name: "Cost" })).toHaveAttribute("title", "Cost");`
     Assert `expect(screen.getByRole("img", { name: "Target" })).toHaveAttribute("title", "Target");`
     Under `zh-CN`:
     Assert `expect(screen.getByRole("img", { name: "费用" })).toHaveAttribute("title", "费用");`
     Assert `expect(screen.getByRole("img", { name: "目标" })).toHaveAttribute("title", "目标");`
   - In `it("#2269 #2574 a hand card whose view has tradable: true gets the pip; one without does not")`:
     Assert `expect(pip).toHaveAttribute("title", "Tradable");`
   - In `it("#2269 a Tradable card by its printed keywords gets the pip, dimmed once the turn's Trade is spent")`:
     Assert `expect(pip).toHaveAttribute("title", "Tradable");`
     Assert `expect(spent).toHaveAttribute("title", "No Trades left this turn");`
     Under `zh-CN`:
     Assert `expect(zh).toHaveAttribute("title", "本回合没有剩余交易次数");`
     Assert `expect(screen.getByRole("img", { name: "可交易" })).toHaveAttribute("title", "可交易");`
   - In `it("R2574000 the Tradable pip reads card.tradable instead of printed keywords")`:
     Assert `expect(pip).toHaveAttribute("title", "Tradable");`
     Assert `expect(spent).toHaveAttribute("title", "No Trades left this turn");`
     Under `zh-CN`:
     Assert `expect(zh).toHaveAttribute("title", "本回合没有剩余交易次数");`
   - In `it("R2268000 a hand card whose view has tribute: 2 wears the Tribute pip showing 2")`:
     Assert `expect(screen.getByRole("img", { name: "Tribute" })).toHaveAttribute("title", "Tribute");`
   - Add a test `it("#4683 every rendered hand-hint pip carries its screen-reader label as hover text (title), including dimmed state")`:
     Renders a card with `COST`, `DIMMED`, and `TRIBUTE_HINT`, and a tradable card with `trades.left === 0`; asserts each rendered pip element's `getAttribute("title")` equals its `getAttribute("aria-label")`.

- [`apps/web/src/game/HandHints.test.tsx`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4683/apps/web/src/game/HandHints.test.tsx):
  - `it("#2267 each pip's accessible label goes through t() in the reader's language")`: asserts `title` attribute matches localized labels for custom hints in English and Chinese.
  - `it("#2269 #2574 a hand card whose view has tradable: true gets the pip; one without does not")`: asserts `title="Tradable"`.

  - Command: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/HandHints.test.tsx`
- [`apps/web/src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4683/apps/web/src/i18n/i18n.test.ts):
  - Verifies all `t()` usages in sources remain accounted for in translations.
  - Command: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`

## Done when
- [ ] `apps/web/src/game/HandHints.tsx` sets `title={pip.label}` on every rendered `.hand-hint` span.
- [ ] Every rendered hand-hint pip carries its screen-reader label as hover text (`title`), including dimmed state and localized strings.
- [ ] Touch and screen-reader behavior unchanged; no layout or CSS style changes.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/HandHints.test.tsx` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/game/HandHints.tsx apps/web/src/game/HandHints.test.tsx` passes.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh catalog check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh patches check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

## Risks
- Accessible name computation: adding `title` to an element with `role="img"` and `aria-label` could theoretically affect accessibility if not conforming to standard AccName rules. Per AccName 1.2 §4.3, `aria-label` takes precedence over `title` for calculating the accessible name, preserving existing screen reader semantics while providing mouse hover text.
- Purity and client rules (CLAUDE.md rule 7): no game logic or aura derivation is performed in the client; labels continue to be sourced directly from `pip.label` as computed by `handHints.ts` from engine view data.
- i18n regressions: no new strings or `t()` call sites are introduced; `pip.label` already routes through `t()`.

None.
````
